name: Purple sprouting broccoli tempura with nuoc cham
assumptions: Recipe as written serves 2 (standard for this style of BBC Good Food starter/light lunch with 200g broccoli and batter quantities)
Total active prep and cooking time estimated at 20 minutes based on instructions (nuoc cham whisking ~5 min + batter/oil prep ~5 min + frying in batches ~10 min)
Fish sauce confirms non-vegetarian/vegan and fish allergen
Plain flour confirms wheat allergen and non-gluten-free
Sesame seeds listed (even if optional) confirm sesame allergen
No dairy, eggs, peanuts, or tree nuts listed
Soy ambiguous (possible in some fish sauces but not specified)
Shellfish null (no explicit shellfish but fish sauce sometimes processed with crustacean elements)
instructions:
step 1
For the nuoc cham, whisk together all of the ingredients with 5 tbsp hot water in a small bowl. Set aside while you make the tempura.

step 2
Whisk the cornflour, plain flour, sesame seeds (if using) and a large pinch of salt together. Fill a large, deep pan no more than a third full with the vegetable oil and heat until it reaches 180C or a cube of bread dropped in browns in 20 seconds.

step 3
Quickly whisk the soda water into the flour mixture, being careful not to overmix, then dunk in the broccoli using tongs. Carefully lower into the hot oil and cook for 2-3 mins until crisp. Drain on kitchen paper, then serve with the nuoc cham on the side for dipping.

ingredients.name: Corn Flour
ingredients.assumptions: Standard white cornflour (cornstarch) values; used entirely in batter.
